criteria.name: Fact investigation & the minor-client interview
criteria.description: Elicits the client's own account through developmentally appropriate, non-leading questioning; builds a chronology; identifies the conflicting accounts and the evidentiary gaps (obscured handoff, ambiguous doorway contact).

subcriteria.name: Eliciting the account without leading
subcriteria.description: Uses open-ended prompts and secures Tobias's own version before the adults reshape it; reaches the rapport-gated facts through the proper triggers, not pressure.

subcriteria.name: Chronology & proof-gap analysis
subcriteria.description: Assembles an accurate chronology and expressly flags every conflict and evidentiary gap in the file.

criteria.name: Counseling the distressed juvenile and parent
criteria.description: Builds trust with a frightened minor and manages an overwhelmed parent, keeping the child's voice and priorities primary.

subcriteria.name: Rapport & developmentally appropriate communication
subcriteria.description: Communicates with Tobias in a calm, non-judgmental, age-appropriate way that preserves his confidence.

subcriteria.name: Managing the parent's role & expectations
subcriteria.description: Handles Dana's distress and guilt, corrects misunderstandings, and keeps decision-making centered on the client.

criteria.name: Disposition strategy: diversion vs. contested hearing
criteria.description: Analyzes the diversion offer against a contested hearing and prepares a negotiation plan, including a restitution position grounded in the intact recovery.

subcriteria.name: Risk/benefit analysis of the diversion offer
subcriteria.description: Weighs the no-record benefit against the responsibility requirement and the innocence claim; states best- and worst-case outcomes.

subcriteria.name: Negotiation plan with the county attorney
subcriteria.description: Prepares a concrete negotiation plan on terms and restitution, using the recovered-console leverage.

criteria.name: Professional responsibility
criteria.description: Identifies and correctly navigates the Rule 4.2 no-contact problem and the confidentiality dynamics of a minor client with a parent present.

subcriteria.name: Rule 4.2 — the represented co-respondent
subcriteria.description: Spots that Kellan is represented and does not contact him directly; routes any inquiry through his counsel.

subcriteria.name: Confidentiality & the parent/child dynamic
subcriteria.description: Handles privilege and confidentiality with a parent present, and the honesty question raised by concealed prior conduct.
